name: Sasaki Jin
source:
The sole proprietor of a construction and renovation business. He has been a childhood friend of Kuze for more than 20 years. Despite the difference in family background between them, they seem to be attracted to each other and keep in touch even after they split up after high school and university. He is like a big brother who worries about Kuze's mental and physical health.

[Translated from the [url=http://pro-page.jp/fpp/uuudiary-disk/character.html]Official Website[/url]]
